title: Block Out Level 5 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 5 is a cramped checkerboard between two red columns. Strip the white pieces out through the right gate, let the black blocks collapse into a staircase for the lower-left exit, and save the last red column for the finish.

landmarks: Block Out Level 5 is a cramped checkerboard between two red columns.
Strip the white pieces out through the right gate, let the black blocks collapse into a staircase for the lower-left exit, and save the last red column for the finish.
The board mixes Red, White, Black and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Black needs to form a staircase before the left gate is useful.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Feed the lowest white piece on the right edge out through the white gate.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Use the new pocket to peel the next white pieces toward the same exit instead of touching the tall red columns.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Let the black pieces collapse into the lower-center staircase while the center rows are being cleared.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Once most of the whites are gone, send the bottom black pieces left into the black gate and then pull the higher black square down into the same channel.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Keep the red columns parked until the white exit and black gate are both finished with their traffic.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish by running the remaining tall red column across the cleared top lane and out through the left red gate.

failurePoints: Sliding one of the tall red columns before the black staircase has formed.
Using the right-side white pocket for red movement instead of spending it on another white exit.
